external_sources.title: Commission issues Guidance Document on submission of price undertaking offers for battery electric vehicles from China

external_sources.supports: Discussion of minimum import price, sales channels, cross-compensation and future investments. Each offer is assessed individually under legal criteria.

external_sources.title: Joint Statement at the second meeting of the EU-China Trade and Investment Consultations
external_sources.read_scope: Official two-page statement; annex points 2–4 checked.
external_sources.supports: Trade-monitoring cooperation, an understanding on hybrid-vehicle trade and continuation of BEV price-undertaking/review procedures.
